_doc: Every number a cooked dish gives (the kitchen rebuild, 2026-11-14; src/kitchen.py reads it). A dish has one main benefit (hp, sp, mp, stat or special: its menu tab). Its tier is the band of its deepest ingredient, one tier more for a big dish (big_dish). Its worth is the sum of what its ingredients add (worth, below) times the size bonus for how many different ingredients it has (size_mult). Lists by tier hold tiers 1 to 5. No recipe carries a number of its own.

big_dish._doc: Big dishes +1 tier (Brandon, 2026-11-16, on a five-part Wild Game Pie of floors 1 to 4 that was only tier 1): a dish of parts or more different ingredients is tier_bonus tiers above the band of its deepest ingredient, at most tier 5 (kitchen.dish_tier). The raised tier is the dish's tier everywhere: the cooking question, the stat cap it teaches to, its numbers, its picture. The size bonus (size_mult) is apart and unchanged.

worth._doc: What one ingredient adds to a dish's worth: a monster part or trophy 1, a foraged find 0.6, a ration 0.5.

size_mult._doc: A dish of N different ingredients is worth this many times the sum of what they add: about 1.2x at two, rising to 1.6x at five. Saving parts for a bigger dish pays.

rungs._doc: The kitchen's two low rungs (Brandon, 2026-11-22, on rations, bread and cheese piling up: 'more recipes that use these ONLY... as well as monster recipes that are just ONE step above a single monster ingredient'). A recipe names its rung. plain: a dish of staples alone. Its main benefit is main times a dish's, its heal is heal_written (0: only what an HP dish's share or the foods themselves give) and it adds max_hp (0: only a creature's part builds a hero, 'you are what you eat'). step: one creature's part and one staple, an ordinary dish of two. On both, cooked_over_raw is the least a dish gives of the SP and HP its ingredients would give eaten as they are. A dish with no rung is untouched by all of this.

every_dish._doc: What any dish cooked right gives, whatever its tab: SP (scaled by worth), a small heal (food_system.meal_mend_share of heal_written), and max_hp toward the floor's cap (Player.PER_FLOOR_HP_CAP). These keep a single dish near the old tier bands. Plain fare has its own heal and max HP (rungs).

hp._doc: The HP tab: heals this share of max HP (times worth, at most all of it) and adds max_hp_bonus (times worth) on top of every dish's max HP, inside the floor's cap. Plain fare adds none (rungs).

sp._doc: The SP tab: restores sp (times worth) in place of every dish's SP, and the hero is Sustained (hunger at half pace) for sustained_turns (times worth), at most sustained_cap.

mp._doc: The MP tab: restores this share of max MP (times worth), or least (times worth) if that is more: max MP is small while Intelligence is low.

stat._doc: The Stat tab: a stat dish cooked right teaches its stat one whole point, the floor's one stat lesson (Player.feed_cut_stat). How far a dish can raise a stat is set by its TIER (Brandon, 2026-11-16: caps by dish tier 'stop early spamming' and make 'deep and complex cooking way more important'): food and the altar's rededication together may not take a stat past cap_by_tier[tier - 1] points above where it began, or wis_cap_by_tier for Wisdom (half: the dungeon teaches it a point every three floors, and every point is a second on the clock). The table is the old depth rule (3 + floor / 4) at the bottom of each band, so tier 5 keeps its ceiling of 28 (Wisdom 14). An altar's rededication and a rare food's own gift go by the band of the deepest floor reached.

special._doc: The Special tab: a timed power for turns (times worth), at most the power's max_turns. A ward (save_guard_*) is stronger with worth: +1, +2 from ward_worth[1], +3 from ward_worth[2].

legendary._doc: A legendary feast (five ingredients, deep, often a boss trophy) gives its main benefit times mult, and a permanent bonus by its tab: hp max_hp past the floor's cap; mp max_mp; stat stat_points past the floor's lesson; special its resistance for good. Max HP has no cap across floors (Brandon, 2026-11-16: 'a per floor limit to hp gained, but not a max across several floors'), so the feast's max HP always lands. Max MP from feasts has a cap on each floor only (max_mp_floor_cap; Brandon, 2026-11-17: MP 'same as HP'). The stat stays inside the stat's cap for the feast's tier (Player.cooking_stat_softcap, stat.cap_by_tier). A trophy's dish gives its trophy's own permanent power, and so does a feast that holds the trophy.

salvage._doc: Persephone's Descent: a ruined dish still gives this share of its SP, healing and mana.

search._doc: A person's body is searched, never harvested (Brandon, 2026-11-16: 'that's weird, we're not cannibals'; the people are data/items/harvest_map.json 'people'). H on the body takes what the person carried, like picking it up: no question, the body is used up, and count[0] to count[1] ordinary finds (food_system.search_finds). Each is drawn from pack by its weight for the floor's band (five weights, tiers 1 to 5), never one whose own first floor is deeper than the floor. A person of a tag in by_tag, or a family in by_family, carries one of those first (a cultist his incense, an elf his waybread). Only ordinary food and foraged finds: never a meat of a new kind.
